## Private content reminder

**IMPORTANT**: Before attaching any logs, evidence bundles, or diagnostic output:
- Do NOT include your API tokens, secret keys, or authentication credentials
- Do NOT include absolute file paths from your machine (e.g., `/Users/yourname/...`)
- Do NOT attach `.chimera-memory/` ledger directories — these may contain sensitive internal records
- Review all pasted text for secrets and redact before posting

We will never ask for your credentials.
